key: I know it's been a lot of work, but we're almost there!
en: I know it's been a lot of work, but we're almost there!
ja: 大変だったのは分かってます、でももうすぐです!

key: We can finish this!
en: We can finish this!
ja: やり遂げられます!

key: BEE: Oh hey! It's you!
en: BEE: Oh hey! It's you!
ja: ビー: あ! あなたですね!

key: I hope you and that Pokémon are doing well!
en: I hope you and that Pokémon are doing well!
ja: あなたとあのポケモン、元気にしてるといいんですけど!

key: I'm working hard on getting the report published.
en: I'm working hard on getting the report published.
ja: 論文を発表するために頑張ってます。

key: Soon it'll be famous!
en: Soon it'll be famous!
ja: もうすぐ有名になりますよ!

key: BEE: Oh, hey there.
en: BEE: Oh, hey there.
ja: ビー: あ、どうも。

key: I hope you're doing well on your quest.
en: I hope you're doing well on your quest.
ja: あなたの冒険、順調だといいんですけど。

key: I'm... still not sure where to go for mine.
en: I'm... still not sure where to go for mine.
ja: あたしは……まだ自分の道がどっちなのか分からなくて。

key: But that's okay, right?
en: But that's okay, right?
ja: でも、それでいいですよね?

key: I'll figure it out when I'm ready.
en: I'll figure it out when I'm ready.
ja: 準備ができたら、ちゃんと見つかるはずです。

key: For now I just gotta hang in there!
en: For now I just gotta hang in there!
ja: 今はとにかく踏ん張るしかないです!

key: BEE: Okay, so I know this might be kind of a quick turn around--
en: BEE: Okay, so I know this might be kind of a quick turn around--
ja: ビー: あの、ちょっと急な話かもしれないんですけど――

key: But I just realized, ever since those doors to the alternate portals opened,
en: But I just realized, ever since those doors to the alternate portals opened,
ja: でも今さら気づいたんですが、別次元へのポータルが開いてからというもの、

key: There's been an entirely new class of Pokémon?
en: There's been an entirely new class of Pokémon?
ja: まったく新しい分類のポケモンがいるんですよね?

key: That are like Pokémon but somehow aren't Pokémon?
en: That are like Pokémon but somehow aren't Pokémon?
ja: ポケモンみたいだけど、なぜかポケモンじゃないっていう?

key: Anyway, the point is I love them.
en: Anyway, the point is I love them.
ja: とにかく、要はあたしそれが大好きなんです。

key: And I MUST know more.
en: And I MUST know more.
ja: もっと知らなきゃ気が済みません。

key: If you can, you have to catch every single one of them!
en: If you can, you have to catch every single one of them!
ja: できるなら、一匹残らず捕まえてきてください!

key: The Ultra Beasts, that is!
en: The Ultra Beasts, that is!
ja: ウルトラビーストのことです!

key: You actually did it!
en: You actually did it!
ja: 本当にやり遂げたんですね!

key: Fantastic!
en: Fantastic!
ja: すばらしい!

key: Amazing!
en: Amazing!
ja: すごい!

key: Splendiferous!
en: Splendiferous!
ja: 素晴らしすぎます!

key: I promise you here and now, I'm going to become the foremost Ultra Beast researcher in the world,
en: I promise you here and now, I'm going to become the foremost Ultra Beast researcher in the world,
ja: ここではっきり約束します、あたしは世界一のウルトラビースト研究者になります、

key: And this will be my stepping stone!!!
en: And this will be my stepping stone!!!
ja: そのための足がかりが、これです!!!

key: Wait, does calling your work and help a stepping stone sound demeaning?
en: Wait, does calling your work and help a stepping stone sound demeaning?
ja: あ、待って、あなたの手伝いを「足がかり」なんて呼ぶの、失礼に聞こえます?

key: I don't want to be demeaning-- we can be co-authors on my first thesis?
en: I don't want to be demeaning-- we can be co-authors on my first thesis?
ja: 見下すつもりはないんです――最初の論文、共著にしませんか?

key: Oh, but I've never been fond of writing...
en: Oh, but I've never been fond of writing...
ja: あ、でも、あたし文章を書くのって得意じゃなくて……

key: Maybe it's simply enough to enjoy having the knowledge for its own sake!
en: Maybe it's simply enough to enjoy having the knowledge for its own sake!
ja: 知識そのものを楽しむだけで十分なのかもしれません!

key: Yes, that must be true!
en: Yes, that must be true!
ja: そう、きっとそうです!

key: What is knowledge for if not to be known?
en: What is knowledge for if not to be known?
ja: 知られないなら、知識にどんな意味があるんでしょう?

key: ...Oh, right, I said we'd work something out.
en: ...Oh, right, I said we'd work something out.
ja: ……あ、そうだ、何かお礼するって言ってましたね。

key: So I found this cool stone when I was investigating one of those pocket dimensions--
en: So I found this cool stone when I was investigating one of those pocket dimensions--
ja: あのポケット次元のひとつを調べてたときに、素敵な石を見つけたんです――

key: Or PokéDims, as I've started calling them--
en: Or PokéDims, as I've started calling them--
ja: あたし的には「ポケディム」って呼んでるんですけど――

key: Anyway, here!
en: Anyway, here!
ja: とにかく、はい!

key: BEE: Pretty, isn't it?
en: BEE: Pretty, isn't it?
ja: ビー: きれいでしょ?

key: No idea what it is, but I think it's neat.
en: No idea what it is, but I think it's neat.
ja: 何なのかは分からないけど、いいものだと思うんです。

key: Thanks again!
en: Thanks again!
ja: 改めてありがとうございました!

key: If you do, come back and we'll work something out!
en: If you do, come back and we'll work something out!
ja: 見つけたら、また来てください。お礼を考えますから!

key: BEE: ...So actually!
en: BEE: ...So actually!
ja: ビー: ……あの、実は!

key: I mean...
en: I mean...
ja: ていうか……

key: We've already come this far, right?
en: We've already come this far, right?
ja: もうここまで来たわけですよね?

key: Over 700 species, plus all the Ultra Beasts...
en: Over 700 species, plus all the Ultra Beasts...
ja: 700種類以上に加えて、ウルトラビーストも全部……

key: Thanks to the PokéDims, maybe it's possible to go all the way?
en: Thanks to the PokéDims, maybe it's possible to go all the way?
ja: ポケディムのおかげで、最後まで行けるかもしれない?

key: What do you say we go for broke, partner?
en: What do you say we go for broke, partner?
ja: どうです、思い切ってやってみませんか、相棒?

key: 100% 'Dex completion, partner!
en: 100% 'Dex completion, partner!
ja: 図鑑コンプリート100%、目指しましょう、相棒!

key: You think you can do it?
en: You think you can do it?
ja: できると思います?

key: ...And by golly, you actually have.
en: ...And by golly, you actually have.
ja: ……そして、まさか本当にやってのけましたね。

key: What absolute Champion--
en: What absolute Champion--
ja: なんてチャンピオンなの――

key: Literally, I guess.
en: Literally, I guess.
ja: 文字通りの意味で、ですけど。

key: And you went out and caught all-but-God too.
en: And you went out and caught all-but-God too.
ja: それに、神様みたいなの以外は全部捕まえてきたんですよね。

key: You don't get to see it very often!
en: You don't get to see it very often!
ja: なかなか見られるものじゃないですよ!

key: And even when you do see it, it's usually in a region that has a lot fewer 'Mons than this one.
en: And even when you do see it, it's usually in a region that has a lot fewer 'Mons than this one.
ja: しかも見られたとしても、大抵はこの地方よりポケモンの数がずっと少ない地方でのことですし。

key: I'll be.
en: I'll be.
ja: いやはや。

key: ...I'll Bee!
en: ...I'll Bee!
ja: ……いやビー!

key: Heh, haven't gotten to use that one in a while.
en: Heh, haven't gotten to use that one in a while.
ja: ふふ、久しぶりにこのネタ使えました。

key: Anyway, congrats, Champ!
en: Anyway, congrats, Champ!
ja: とにかく、おめでとうございます、チャンプ!

key: I wish I had something more to give you, but--
en: I wish I had something more to give you, but--
ja: もっと何かあげられたらいいんですけど――

key: Let's be honest, at the point that you're at, what's left?
en: Let's be honest, at the point that you're at, what's left?
ja: 正直、あなたのレベルまで来たら、他に何が残ってます?

key: Not a whole lot, that's for sure.
en: Not a whole lot, that's for sure.
ja: 確かに、あんまり無いですよね。

key: ...Which is why, I had the good sense to radio down the Grand Hall and speak to one Mx. Adrienn Flores for just this occasion.
en: ...Which is why, I had the good sense to radio down the Grand Hall and speak to one Mx. Adrienn Flores for just this occasion.
ja: ……というわけで、こんな時のためにグランドホールに連絡して、アドリエンヌ・フローレス様にお話ししておいたんです。

key: Xe prepped this in advance for when you inevitably came along and did the impossible.
en: Xe prepped this in advance for when you inevitably came along and did the impossible.
ja: あの方は、あなたがいつか必ずここまでやってのける日のために、これを前もって用意してくれていました。

key: This is from both of us, Champ.
en: This is from both of us, Champ.
ja: これはあたしたち二人から、チャンプへ。

key: Congratulations!
en: Congratulations!
ja: おめでとうございます!

key: BEE: I'll hang onto this for you in case you wanna see it again.
en: BEE: I'll hang onto this for you in case you wanna see it again.
ja: ビー: また見たくなった時のために、これはあたしが預かっておきますね。

key: And uh, here's a little something from me too!
en: And uh, here's a little something from me too!
ja: あ、それと、これはあたしからのちょっとしたものです!

key: Just a pretty rock I found when I was out 'splorin!
en: Just a pretty rock I found when I was out 'splorin!
ja: 探検中に見つけたきれいな石なんですけど!

key: Thought you might like it.
en: Thought you might like it.
ja: 気に入ってもらえるかなと思って。

key: Thanks for all the help, and for being just a knock-out hero!
en: Thanks for all the help, and for being just a knock-out hero!
ja: いろいろ手伝ってくれて、それに本物の英雄でいてくれてありがとうございます!

key: I, for one, have full faith in you!
en: I, for one, have full faith in you!
ja: あたしはあなたのこと、心から信じてます!

key: You've come this far, right?
en: You've come this far, right?
ja: ここまで来たんですものね?

key: Nothing to it but to do it!
en: Nothing to it but to do it!
ja: あとはやるだけです!

key: BEE: Come to take a gander at your shiny certificate?
en: BEE: Come to take a gander at your shiny certificate?
ja: ビー: あの輝く認定証、また見に来たんですか?

key: BEE: It'll always be here.
en: BEE: It'll always be here.
ja: ビー: いつでもここにありますから。

key: And in your heart.
en: And in your heart.
ja: それと、あなたの心の中にも。

key: Or something-- xe said something like that but I didn't quite follow.
en: Or something-- xe said something like that but I didn't quite follow.
ja: ……みたいなことを、あの方が言ってたんですけど、あたしよく分かってなくて。

key: If you ask me, a certificate in your heart sounds like a health risk, but I'm not the expert here.
en: If you ask me, a certificate in your heart sounds like a health risk, but I'm not the expert here.
ja: あたしに言わせれば、心の中に認定証があるなんて健康に良くなさそうですけど、専門家じゃないので何とも。

key: Excuse me!
en: Excuse me!
ja: すみません!

key: Hello! If I recall, one of my nephews used to talk a little bit about you!
en: Hello! If I recall, one of my nephews used to talk a little bit about you!
ja: こんにちは! たしか、うちのおいっ子があなたのことを少し話してた気がするわ!

key: He said you and his group of friends were pretty fond of Fire-type Pokémon!
en: He said you and his group of friends were pretty fond of Fire-type Pokémon!
ja: あなたとお友達のグループは、ほのおタイプのポケモンが結構好きだって言ってたのよ!

key: I happen to be looking for a Basculin!
en: I happen to be looking for a Basculin!
ja: ちょうどバスラオを探してるところなの!

key: I have a Litten for trade if you have one!
en: I have a Litten for trade if you have one!
ja: もしいるなら、ニャビーと交換できるわよ!

key: Do you?
en: Do you?
ja: 持ってる?

key: Dang... Well I'll be here if you change your mind later, sweetie!
en: Dang... Well I'll be here if you change your mind later, sweetie!
ja: あら残念……気が変わったら、ここにいるからね!

key: \PN traded Basculin for Litten!
en: \PN traded Basculin for Litten!
ja: \PNはバスラオとニャビーを交換した!

key: Thank you so much! Take good care of that Litten now!
en: Thank you so much! Take good care of that Litten now!
ja: どうもありがとう! そのニャビー、ちゃんとかわいがってあげてね!

key: Dang... Well, I'll be here if you change your mind later, sweetie!
en: Dang... Well, I'll be here if you change your mind later, sweetie!
ja: あら残念……気が変わったら、ここにいるからね!

key: Oh, excuse me!
en: Oh, excuse me!
ja: あら、すみません!

key: Trying to organize these books is a pain--
en: Trying to organize these books is a pain--
ja: この本を整理するのが大変で――

key: Where did all of these even come from!?
en: Where did all of these even come from!?
ja: これ、一体どこから来たのかしら!?

key: Oh, hello again!
en: Oh, hello again!
ja: あら、またお会いしましたね!

key: I hope Litten is doing well!
en: I hope Litten is doing well!
ja: ニャビー、元気にしてるといいけど!

key: Back to these books I guess though...
en: Back to these books I guess though...
ja: さて、また本の整理に戻らないと……

key: See you!
en: See you!
ja: またね!

key: Hey, you.
en: Hey, you.
ja: ねえ、あんた。

key: I know you used to hang with one of my cousins in the Aqua Gang.
en: I know you used to hang with one of my cousins in the Aqua Gang.
ja: あんたが昔、アクアギャングにいたあたしのいとことつるんでたのは知ってるよ。

key: Considering you joined them, I assume that you like Water-types, yes?
en: Considering you joined them, I assume that you like Water-types, yes?
ja: あそこに入ってたってことは、みずタイプが好きなんでしょ?

key: I'm looking for an Oranguru.
en: I'm looking for an Oranguru.
ja: ヤレユータンを探してるの。

key: I'm willing to trade an Oshawott for one.
en: I'm willing to trade an Oshawott for one.
ja: ミジュマルと交換してもいいわよ。

key: What do you say?
en: What do you say?
ja: どう?

key: Awesome. Let's do this.
en: Awesome. Let's do this.
ja: よし。やろう。

key: That's a shame. Well, maybe later if you change your mind.
en: That's a shame. Well, maybe later if you change your mind.
ja: 残念ね。まあ、気が変わったらまた今度。

key: \PN traded Oranguru for Oshawott!
en: \PN traded Oranguru for Oshawott!
ja: \PNはヤレユータンとミジュマルを交換した!

key: Awesome, thanks! Take good care of that guy!
en: Awesome, thanks! Take good care of that guy!
ja: よし、ありがと! ちゃんとかわいがってあげてね!

key: That's a shame.
en: That's a shame.
ja: 残念ね。

key: Well, maybe later if you change your mind.
en: Well, maybe later if you change your mind.
ja: まあ、気が変わったらまた今度。

key: Do you need something?
en: Do you need something?
ja: 何か用?

key: If not I'd advise leaving. I'm not one for strangers.
en: If not I'd advise leaving. I'm not one for strangers.
ja: でなければ、帰ることをお勧めするわ。あたし、見知らぬ人は苦手なの。

key: Thanks again for the Oranguru!
en: Thanks again for the Oranguru!
ja: ヤレユータン、改めてありがとう!

key: Hope that Oshawott is doing all right.
en: Hope that Oshawott is doing all right.
ja: そのミジュマル、元気にしてるといいけど。

key: Zzz...
en: Zzz...
ja: Zzz……

key: ...H-huh?
en: ...H-huh?
ja: ……え、あれ?

key: O-oh! I must have fallen asleep!
en: O-oh! I must have fallen asleep!
ja: あ、あら! 眠っちゃってたみたい!

key: I was supposed to go on a hike to Route 4 to meet my friend...
en: I was supposed to go on a hike to Route 4 to meet my friend...
ja: 4番道路までハイキングして、友達に会う予定だったのに……

key: Eh?
en: Eh?
ja: え?

key: It's been how long!?
en: It's been how long!?
ja: どれくらい経ったの!?

key: Gosh, I guess I totally stood him up!
en: Gosh, I guess I totally stood him up!
ja: やだ、完全にすっぽかしちゃった!

key: Well, no sense sitting around here. I'll just go myself anyway!
en: Well, no sense sitting around here. I'll just go myself anyway!
ja: まあ、ここに座っててもしょうがないし。とにかく自分で行ってくるわ!

key: Thanks for waking me up!
en: Thanks for waking me up!
ja: 起こしてくれてありがとう!

key: Maybe I'll see you around!
en: Maybe I'll see you around!
ja: またどこかで会えるといいわね!

key: SARENA: Oh, what's the matter?
en: SARENA: Oh, what's the matter?
ja: サレナ: あら、どうしたの?

key: Decided you wanted to listen to the crazy lady with the computer ramble?
en: Decided you wanted to listen to the crazy lady with the computer ramble?
ja: パソコン相手にブツブツ言ってる変な女の話でも聞きたくなった?

key: ???: Tch, this stupid thing...
en: ???: Tch, this stupid thing...
ja: ???: チッ、このバカな機械……

key: ???: Oh, I didn't hear anyone come in.
en: ???: Oh, I didn't hear anyone come in.
ja: ???: あら、入ってくる音、聞こえなかったわ。

key: Blame it on me being just a little FRUSTRATED with this old piece of trash.
en: Blame it on me being just a little FRUSTRATED with this old piece of trash.
ja: このオンボロのガラクタに、ちょっとイラついてただけよ。

key: Oh, where are my manners, or whatever?
en: Oh, where are my manners, or whatever?
ja: あら、礼儀を忘れてたわね、っていうか。

key: Name's Sarena. I'm the property manager here in Agate City.
en: Name's Sarena. I'm the property manager here in Agate City.
ja: 名前はサレナ。ここアゲートシティの物件管理人よ。

key: I know what you did for the city, and I appreciate that.
en: I know what you did for the city, and I appreciate that.
ja: あんたがこの街のためにやったこと、ちゃんと知ってるし、感謝してる。

key: Seriously, I have no intentions to sleep again for the next seven years.
en: Seriously, I have no intentions to sleep again for the next seven years.
ja: マジで、この先7年は二度と眠るつもりないから。

key: And at the rate THIS is going, that's not an exaggeration.
en: And at the rate THIS is going, that's not an exaggeration.
ja: このペースだと、大げさでもなんでもないのよね。

key: Do you care?
en: Do you care?
ja: 興味ある?

key: SARENA: Kind of you. Then lemme explain.
en: SARENA: Kind of you. Then lemme explain.
ja: サレナ: 優しいのね。じゃあ説明するわ。

key: I'm kind of new to the job.
en: I'm kind of new to the job.
ja: あたし、この仕事始めたばっかりなの。

key: Took over after the last property manager had an accident in Reborn City.
en: Took over after the last property manager had an accident in Reborn City.
ja: リボーンシティで前の物件管理人が事故に遭ったあと、この仕事を引き継いだの。

key: That was before the renovation, so, you know,
en: That was before the renovation, so, you know,
ja: それは改修前の話だから、まあ、

key: What else would you expect if you frequent that place?
en: What else would you expect if you frequent that place?
ja: あの場所に通い詰めてれば、そりゃそうなるでしょって話よね。

key: Anyway, I've been checking over all the records and such-- MIND-NUMBINGLY boring, by the way--
en: Anyway, I've been checking over all the records and such-- MIND-NUMBINGLY boring, by the way--
ja: とにかく、記録を全部チェックしてるんだけど――ちなみに、頭がおかしくなりそうなくらい退屈――

key: For whatever reason, this address alone is missing all of its documentation.
en: For whatever reason, this address alone is missing all of its documentation.
ja: なぜか、この住所だけ書類が全部そろってないの。

key: There's no indication whatsoever as to who the owner is, when it was sold, or what its standing is.
en: There's no indication whatsoever as to who the owner is, when it was sold, or what its standing is.
ja: 所有者が誰か、いつ売却されたか、今どういう状態なのか、手がかりが何一つないのよ。

key: So I came here to check it out.
en: So I came here to check it out.
ja: だから確認しに来たわけ。

key: As you can see, "lived in" would be a generous summary of its condition.
en: As you can see, "lived in" would be a generous summary of its condition.
ja: 見ての通り、「人が住んでる」って言うのはこの状態には甘すぎる表現ね。

key: I don't think anyone's stayed here for years.
en: I don't think anyone's stayed here for years.
ja: 何年もここに誰も住んでないと思うわ。

key: Saw this little piece of trash over here, and thought I could figure out who the place belonged to if I poked around.
en: Saw this little piece of trash over here, and thought I could figure out who the place belonged to if I poked around.
ja: このガラクタを見つけて、いじってみればここの持ち主が分かるかもって思ったの。

key: That was my first mistake.
en: That was my first mistake.
ja: それが最初の間違いだった。

key: This thing needs a password.
en: This thing needs a password.
ja: こいつ、パスワードが必要みたい。

key: Looks like six digits.
en: Looks like six digits.
ja: 6桁っぽいわね。

key: I'd say I don't have a clue what it is, but that's not quite true.
en: I'd say I don't have a clue what it is, but that's not quite true.
ja: 見当もつかないって言いたいところだけど、それは正確じゃないわね。

key: The one clue I have is this--
en: The one clue I have is this--
ja: 唯一の手がかりはこれ――

key: A Team Meteor logo on the bottom of the screen.
en: A Team Meteor logo on the bottom of the screen.
ja: 画面の下にあるメテオ団のロゴよ。

key: I've already combed this place and there's nothing to tell me what it is.
en: I've already combed this place and there's nothing to tell me what it is.
ja: ここはもう隅々まで調べたけど、正体を教えてくれるものは何もなかったわ。

key: For better or worse, I'm not too willing to get mixed up with Team Meteor to find out more either.
en: For better or worse, I'm not too willing to get mixed up with Team Meteor to find out more either.
ja: 良くも悪くも、これ以上調べるためにメテオ団に関わりたいとも思わないし。

key: I'm thinking that's where you come in.
en: I'm thinking that's where you come in.
ja: だから、あんたの出番かなって思ってるの。

key: I see you've got one of Meteor's ID cards there.
en: I see you've got one of Meteor's ID cards there.
ja: あんた、メテオ団のIDカードを持ってるみたいね。

key: I won't ask questions because I know you're on the right side,
en: I won't ask questions because I know you're on the right side,
ja: あんたが正しい側にいるのは分かってるから、詮索はしないけど、

key: But if you can think of anywhere that card could get you into, maybe there'll be a hint there as to whoever owns this heap.
en: But if you can think of anywhere that card could get you into, maybe there'll be a hint there as to whoever owns this heap.
ja: そのカードで入れる場所に心当たりがあるなら、このガラクタの持ち主のヒントがあるかもしれないわね。

key: I've tried brute-forcing the password, but that takes for goddamn ever.
en: I've tried brute-forcing the password, but that takes for goddamn ever.
ja: パスワードを総当たりで試してみたけど、とんでもなく時間がかかるのよ。

key: Still more interesting than the rest of my paperwork though.
en: Still more interesting than the rest of my paperwork though.
ja: それでも、他の書類仕事よりはよっぽど面白いけどね。

key: So, you know, I'll be around.
en: So, you know, I'll be around.
ja: だから、まあ、この辺にいるから。

key: Swing by if you find anything.
en: Swing by if you find anything.
ja: 何か見つけたら寄ってちょうだい。

key: SARENA: Don't blame you.
en: SARENA: Don't blame you.
ja: サレナ: そりゃそうよね。

key: I'm sure you've got better things to do.
en: I'm sure you've got better things to do.
ja: あんたにはもっと他にやることがあるでしょうし。

key: Can't say the same.
en: Can't say the same.
ja: あたしは違うけど。

key: SARENA: Any luck, soldier?
en: SARENA: Any luck, soldier?
ja: サレナ: どう、成果はあった?

key: If you got a password for me, I'll give it a go.
en: If you got a password for me, I'll give it a go.
ja: パスワードがあるなら、試してみるわよ。

key: SARENA: I'll give it a try.
en: SARENA: I'll give it a try.
ja: サレナ: 試してみるわね。

key: SARENA: Well, well.
en: SARENA: Well, well.
ja: サレナ: あら、あら。

key: Way to go, kiddo.
en: Way to go, kiddo.
ja: やるじゃない、坊や。

key: Now let's see what we can see...
en: Now let's see what we can see...
ja: それじゃ、何が見えるか確認しましょ……

key: Mm...
en: Mm...

key: SARENA: Interesting.
en: SARENA: Interesting.
ja: サレナ: 面白いわね。

key: No identifying information, but there's that gem.
en: No identifying information, but there's that gem.
ja: 身元が分かるものはないけど、あの宝石があるわね。

key: SARENA: Let's see what other secrets are buried here.
en: SARENA: Let's see what other secrets are buried here.
ja: サレナ: 他にどんな秘密が埋まってるか見てみましょ。

key: SARENA: No dice.
en: SARENA: No dice.
ja: サレナ: だめね。

key: If that Card can't give you a lead somewhere, I dunno what will.
en: If that Card can't give you a lead somewhere, I dunno what will.
ja: そのカードで手がかりが見つからないなら、もう他に方法が思いつかないわ。

key: SARENA: Well, an additional room is definitely one way to expand the property value.
en: SARENA: Well, an additional room is definitely one way to expand the property value.
ja: サレナ: まあ、部屋を増築するのも物件価値を上げる一つの手ではあるわね。

key: I'm pretty sure you're supposed to get a permit before making additions like that,
en: I'm pretty sure you're supposed to get a permit before making additions like that,
ja: こういう増築の前には許可が必要だったはずだけど、

key: But I'll just assume that got lost with the previous manager.
en: But I'll just assume that got lost with the previous manager.
ja: それも前の管理人と一緒に紛失したってことにしとくわ。

key: Hm?
en: Hm?
ja: ん?

key: There's something written here.
en: There's something written here.
ja: ここに何か書いてある。

key: "I didn't know..."
en: "I didn't know..."
ja: 「知らなかった……」

key: "He tricked me..."
en: "He tricked me..."
ja: 「あいつにだまされた……」

key: Whoever was here had some problems.
en: Whoever was here had some problems.
ja: ここにいた誰かは、色々問題を抱えてたみたいね。

key: And what's with all this crap on the ground?
en: And what's with all this crap on the ground?
ja: それに、床に散らばってるこのガラクタは何なの?

key: SARENA: ...
en: SARENA: ...
ja: サレナ: ……

key: "I have to fix it..."
en: "I have to fix it..."
ja: 「直さなくちゃ……」

key: "I'll get them all back..."
en: "I'll get them all back..."
ja: 「あいつら全員に仕返ししてやる……」

key: "History was in my hands,
en: "History was in my hands,
ja: 「歴史はこの手の中にあった、

key: And then my skull.
en: And then my skull.
ja: それから、この頭蓋の中に。

key: It is written by the winner, so I must take up the pen.
en: It is written by the winner, so I must take up the pen.
ja: 歴史とは勝者が書くもの、だから私はペンを取らねばならぬ。

key: Nose to the grindstone, eye to the needle.
en: Nose to the grindstone, eye to the needle.
ja: 鼻先をといしに、目を針の先に。

key: The sword follows only after."
en: The sword follows only after."
ja: 剣はそのあとに続くのみ」

key: New plan.
en: New plan.
ja: 新しい計画にするわ。

key: There's no record of this house's owner, so it doesn't have one.
en: There's no record of this house's owner, so it doesn't have one.
ja: この家の所有者の記録がないなら、所有者はいないってことにする。

key: Reading this, I'm convinced it's better that way.
en: Reading this, I'm convinced it's better that way.
ja: これを読んだ今、そのほうがいいってはっきり分かったわ。

key: I'll clean up the paperwork and get it on the market like, eventually or something.
en: I'll clean up the paperwork and get it on the market like, eventually or something.
ja: 書類を片付けて、そのうち市場に出すことにするわね。

key: SARENA: Thanks for your help.
en: SARENA: Thanks for your help.
ja: サレナ: 手伝ってくれてありがとう。

key: It's been, uh...
en: It's been, uh...
ja: なんていうか、その……

key: Weird.
en: Weird.
ja: 変な経験だったわ。

key: Here's some appreciation.
en: Here's some appreciation.
ja: これ、お礼よ。

en: \PN obtained a Department Store Sticker: Manectric!
ja: \PNは「デパートシール: ライボルト」を手に入れた!

key: SARENA: There you go.
en: SARENA: There you go.
ja: サレナ: はい、どうぞ。

key: All right, I'm out of here before I have to read any more creepy slam poetry.
en: All right, I'm out of here before I have to read any more creepy slam poetry.
ja: よし、これ以上不気味なポエムを読まされる前に、あたしはもう行くわね。

key: Thanks for like, bailing me and the city out, or whatever.
en: Thanks for like, bailing me and the city out, or whatever.
ja: あんたのおかげで、あたしも街も助かった、みたいな感じ。

key: ...Is what I would say, if you had a Department Store Card.
en: ...Is what I would say, if you had a Department Store Card.
ja: ……って言いたいところだけど、あんたがデパートカードを持ってたらの話ね。

key: Really, how do you not have one already?
en: Really, how do you not have one already?
ja: ていうか、なんでまだ持ってないのよ?

key: If you go get one, I'll give you a Sticker on it.
en: If you go get one, I'll give you a Sticker on it.
ja: 作ってきたら、シールをあげるわ。

key: SARENA: Did you get your Card?
en: SARENA: Did you get your Card?
ja: サレナ: カード、作った?

key: Oh, finally.
en: Oh, finally.
ja: あら、やっとね。

key: Seriously, no?
en: Seriously, no?
ja: マジでまだなの?

key: What are you waiting for?
en: What are you waiting for?
ja: 何を待ってるのよ?

key: Hey! Hey! You wanna know something?
en: Hey! Hey! You wanna know something?
ja: ねえ! ねえ! 知りたいことない?

key: Down in the basement, there's this really strange room!
en: Down in the basement, there's this really strange room!
ja: 地下室に、すごく変な部屋があるんだよ!

key: And! And! You wanna know what else?
en: And! And! You wanna know what else?
ja: それに! それに! 他にも知りたい?

key: It's really spooky!
en: It's really spooky!
ja: すっごく不気味なの!

key: One time, my friend dared me to stay the night in there, but...
en: One time, my friend dared me to stay the night in there, but...
ja: 前に、友達に「一晩泊まってみろ」って言われたんだけど……

key: I got too scared and had to leave!
en: I got too scared and had to leave!
ja: 怖すぎて出てきちゃった!

key: It's that scary and weird!
en: It's that scary and weird!
ja: それくらい怖くて変なんだよ!

key: Hey! Hey!
en: Hey! Hey!
ja: ねえ! ねえ!

key: D'you wanna see it?
en: D'you wanna see it?
ja: 見てみたい?

key: Okay!
en: Okay!
ja: よし!

key: I'll leave the door open; follow me!
en: I'll leave the door open; follow me!
ja: ドア開けとくから、ついてきて!

key: Oh.
en: Oh.
ja: あ。

key: Which floor?
en: Which floor?
ja: どの階?

key: Ground Floor
en: Ground Floor
ja: 1階

key: Basement Floor
en: Basement Floor
ja: 地下1階

key: It's nice and all to be back in business after sleepin' so long,
en: It's nice and all to be back in business after sleepin' so long,
ja: あんなに長く眠ってたあとで、また仕事に戻れたのはいいことなんだけどさ、

key: But I'm afraid I still hardly know what to do with myself.
en: But I'm afraid I still hardly know what to do with myself.
ja: 正直、自分でも何をすればいいのかまだよく分かんないんだ。

key: My wife is always going on about finding all that Pokémon data...
en: My wife is always going on about finding all that Pokémon data...
ja: うちの奥さんはいつも、ポケモンのデータを全部集めるとか言ってて……

key: I know it would help out with my research, but she doesn't have to be the one to put herself through such lengths when she already has a condition.
en: I know it would help out with my research, but she doesn't have to be the one to put herself through such lengths when she already has a condition.
ja: それが自分の研究の助けになるのは分かるんだけど、彼女には持病があるのに、そこまで無理する必要はないと思うんだよなあ。

key: All this for that little thing...
en: All this for that little thing...
ja: あんな小さなものひとつのために、こんなに……

key: Awwh, geez, I'm soooo far behind on my coursework after being out for so long.
en: Awwh, geez, I'm soooo far behind on my coursework after being out for so long.
ja: あーあ、まったく、あんなに休んでたせいで課題がめちゃくちゃ遅れてるよ。

key: You really think my professor's gonna believe if I say I was asleep the whole time?
en: You really think my professor's gonna believe if I say I was asleep the whole time?
ja: ずっと寝てましたなんて言って、教授が信じてくれると思う?

key: I hear this is a very old city...
en: I hear this is a very old city...
ja: ここはすごく古い街だって聞いたけど……

key: But after it was found completely empty, they cleared away all the old growth and rebuilt it!
en: But after it was found completely empty, they cleared away all the old growth and rebuilt it!
ja: 完全に空っぽの状態で見つかったあと、古いものを全部片付けて建て直したんだって!

key: They did a fabulous job, in my opinion,
en: They did a fabulous job, in my opinion,
ja: あたし的には、すごくいい仕事したと思うんだけど、

key: But what ever happened to the old residents?
en: But what ever happened to the old residents?
ja: 昔の住民たちは一体どうなったのかしら?
